title: Angle on a straight line
observableEvidence: Uses the fact that angles on a straight line sum to 180 degrees to find an unknown angle.
prompt: Two angles sit next to each other on a straight line. One angle measures 65 degrees. What is the measure of the other angle?

figure.svgMarkup: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 240" role="img"><rect width="480" height="240" fill="#ffffff"/><line x1="55" y1="180" x2="425" y2="180" stroke="#22221f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line data-role="angle-ray" x1="240" y1="180" x2="290.714" y2="71.243" stroke="#2c534f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M 300 180 A 60 60 0 0 0 265.357 125.622" fill="none" stroke="#c16b36" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M 190 180 A 50 50 0 0 1 261.131 134.685" fill="none" stroke="#4378a6" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="240" cy="180" r="5" fill="#22221f"/><text x="292" y="136" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#22221f">65 degrees</text><text x="165" y="140" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#22221f">x</text></svg>
figure.altText: A horizontal straight line passes through a vertex. A ray rises up and to the right from the vertex, forming two adjacent angles above the line. The right angle is labeled 65 degrees and the left angle is labeled x.
figure.caption: Two adjacent angles on a straight line.

solutionMethod: Subtract the known angle from 180 degrees, since angles on a straight line sum to 180 degrees.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept with or without the degree symbol or word.

hintSteps.prompt: Angles that sit next to each other on a straight line always add up to a specific total.
hintSteps.question: What do two angles on a straight line always add up to?

hintSteps.prompt: You already know one of the two angle measures.
hintSteps.question: What equation represents the two angles adding to 180?

hintSteps.prompt: This is the same idea as solving 65 + x = 180 for x, just like any missing-addend equation.
hintSteps.question: What value of x makes that equation true?
